evidence_class: Static clarification only; QA ran no command.

clarification.accepted_private_scope: The adopted BVLS05 experiment may change its private numerical representation and isolated experimental contract/binding, including the authorized cfg(test) physical-adapter consumer. Those changes do not alone make the increment Critical.
clarification.terminal_reachability_proof: The terminal review must prove that new BVLS05 paths have no production, shared, default, or public reachability. It must not incorrectly require absence from the authorized private cfg(test) physical adapter.
clarification.authority_scope: A changed isolated experimental contract/binding within the adopted private scope does not itself trigger a production A3 suite. Expansion to production authority, a required authority-suite binding, a protected fixture/cohort, or an anti-evasion posture does.
clarification.solver_scope: Authorized private BVLS05 representation/seam changes remain subject to the declared focused controls, independent operands, real assembly cases, terminal diff, and separate physical readiness. A Critical escalation applies if a change alters shared/default/production solver arithmetic, cutoff/fallback behavior, or an unknown executable path, rather than any private experimental arithmetic representation change.

retained_escalation: Production/shared/default/public reachability or unknown reachability remains Critical.

A physical equation, conservation operand lineage, original G4 input/assertion, production solver cutoff/fallback, authority-suite/fixture/required-case binding, manifest/lockfile/dependency/feature topology, or validation-runner change remains a concrete Critical trigger.
The private physical-adapter route remains separately gated by its named frozen cases and the sole G4 readiness process; this clarification does not release it.
disposition: PASS: no standards conflict. This addendum narrows scope classification language only and leaves every concrete validation and escalation requirement intact.
